She is closely examining light green and pink cloth items laid out on a table. The temple background features vibrant, detailed murals and red pillars under bright indoor lighting. (2) She points to a green garment, speaking to someone off-camera. A small child in a red shirt walks past behind her near wooden stairs. Other visitors are seen in the background, some wearing masks. The camera moves slightly as she interacts with items on the counter. (3) The scene shifts slightly as she moves towards the counter. A quick meme image of an elderly woman with glasses is superimposed when she mentions '66 years old'. She laughs and turns her head toward the camera, her expression cheerful and amused by the interaction.
